items.source: Note that at shutdown, someone should close the underlying Connection via the close() method. Client code will never call close on the Connection handle if it is SmartConnectionFactory-aware (for example, uses ConnectionFactoryUtils.releaseConnection(Connection, ConnectionFactory)).
items.translation: 注意，在关闭时，应通过 `close()` 方法关闭底层的 `Connection`。如果客户端代码是 SmartConnectionFactory-aware（例如，使用ConnectionFactoryUtils.releaseConnection(Connection, ConnectionFactory)），则永远不会调用 `close()` 关闭 `Connection` 句柄。

items.source: This is primarily intended for testing and pipelining usage of connections. For example, it enables easy testing outside an application server for code that expects to work on a ConnectionFactory. Note that this implementation does not act as a connection pool-like utility. Connection pooling requires a pooling ConnectionFactory such as one from r2dbc-pool.
items.translation: 这主要用于测试和连接管道的使用。例如，它使得在应用程序服务器之外轻松测试期望与ConnectionFactory一起工作的代码变得容易。请注意，此实现并不充当连接池工具。连接池需要一个池化ConnectionFactory，例如来自r2dbc-pool的实例。

items.source: If client code will call Connection.close() in the assumption of a pooled Connection, like when using persistence tools, set "suppressClose" to true. This will return a close-suppressing proxy instead of the physical Connection.
items.translation: 如果客户端代码在假设使用连接池（例如在使用持久化工具时）的情况下调用 Connection.close()，请将 "suppressClose" 设置为 true。这将返回一个抑制关闭的代理对象，而不是物理连接。

items.source: As this bean implements DisposableBean, a bean factory will automatically invoke this on destruction of its cached singletons.
items.translation: 由于该 Bean 实现了DisposableBean接口，因此当销毁其缓存的单例时，Bean 工厂会自动调用此方法。
